texts: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Calling all dog lovers! Forty dog breeds, from the family favourites to the super rare ones. You have ten seconds for each. Ready? Let's play!
Kick-off! Here's your first dog breed. Any idea?
Yes! It's a Labrador Retriever. It is one of the most popular family dogs in the world.
Take a good look. Which dog breed is this?
That's a German Shepherd. It is famous as a police and service dog.
Easy one... or is it? Name this dog breed!
It's a Golden Retriever. The breed was developed in Scotland in the 1800s.
Eyes on the screen. What dog breed do we have here?
Correct answer: a Siberian Husky. Huskies were bred to pull sleds over long distances.
You've seen this one before. Which dog breed?
Of course, it's a Dalmatian. Dalmatian puppies are born completely white. The spots come later.
Quick! Which dog breed is this?
Boom! It's a Poodle. Poodles are among the smartest dog breeds.
Trust your instinct. Name it!
Here it is: a Beagle. Beagles have an amazing sense of smell and are used to sniff out food at airports.
Don't overthink it. Which dog breed is this?
You got it, it's a Bulldog. The Bulldog is a national symbol of Britain.
This one is a classic. Which dog breed?
Spot on! It's a Chihuahua. It is one of the smallest dog breeds in the world, named after a Mexican state.
Last easy one! Which dog breed is this?
The answer is a Pug. Pugs come from China, where they lived with emperors.
Medium round! Things get trickier. Which dog breed is this?
Yes! It's a Border Collie. Often called the most intelligent dog breed, it was bred to herd sheep.
Look closely at the details. Which dog breed?
That's a Dachshund. Its name means badger dog in German.
Ten seconds on the clock. Name this dog breed!
It's a Boxer. Boxers are known for playing with their front paws.
This one fools a lot of people. Which dog breed is it?
Correct answer: a Rottweiler. The breed is named after the German town of Rottweil.
Can you get this one right? Which dog breed?
Of course, it's a Shih Tzu. Its name means little lion.
Think carefully. What dog breed is this?
Boom! It's a Yorkshire Terrier. It was first bred to catch rats in English mills.
Here's a tricky one. Name it!
Here it is: a Great Dane. Great Danes are among the tallest dogs in the world.
Got it already? Which dog breed is this?
You got it, it's a Dobermann. It was created in Germany by a tax collector named Louis Dobermann.
Keep that streak going! Which dog breed?
Spot on! It's a Bernese Mountain Dog. It was bred to pull carts on Swiss farms.
Last medium question! Which dog breed is this?
The answer is a Pomeranian. Pomeranians descend from much larger sled dogs.
Hard round! Only the experts from here. Which dog breed is this?
Yes! It's a Shiba Inu. It is one of the oldest dog breeds from Japan.
Not so easy now. Which dog breed?
That's an Akita. The famous loyal dog Hachiko was an Akita.
Here's one for the experts. Name this dog breed!
It's a Basenji. Known as the barkless dog, it yodels instead of barking.
Take your time... but not too much. Which dog breed?
Correct answer: a Weimaraner. Its silver grey coat earned it the nickname the Grey Ghost.
This one is a real head-scratcher. Which dog breed is it?
Of course, it's a Samoyed. Its upturned mouth gives it the famous Samoyed smile.
Big brain time! What dog breed is this?
Boom! It's a Saint Bernard. These dogs were bred to rescue travellers in the Swiss Alps.
Lock in your answer! Which dog breed?
Here it is: an Afghan Hound. Its long silky coat makes it one of the most glamorous breeds.
Few people get this one. Do you?
You got it, it's a Bull Terrier. It is known for its unique egg-shaped head.
Are you still with me? Which dog breed is this?
Spot on! It's a Whippet. Whippets can run faster than 50 kilometres per hour.
Last hard one! Which dog breed?
The answer is a Newfoundland. These giant dogs are excellent swimmers, with webbed feet.
Genius round! Only true masters get these. Which dog breed is this?
Yes! It's a Komondor. Its corded white coat looks like a mop.
Seriously tough now. Name this dog breed!
That's a Xoloitzcuintle. This hairless dog from Mexico has a history going back thousands of years.
If you know this one, you're a legend. Which dog breed?
It's a Puli. This Hungarian herding dog has a black corded coat.
Deep cut! Which dog breed is this?
Correct answer: a Borzoi. It was bred in Russia to hunt wolves.
Here's a rare one. What is it?
Of course, it's a Bedlington Terrier. It looks like a little lamb.
No hints this time. Which dog breed?
Boom! It's a Shar Pei. Famous for its deep wrinkles and blue-black tongue.
Almost there! Which dog breed is this?
Here it is: a Chinese Crested. It is mostly hairless, with silky hair on its head, tail and feet.
Only a handful of people will get this. Which dog breed?
You got it, it's a Saluki. It is one of the oldest known dog breeds, from the Middle East.
Second to last! Name this dog breed!
Spot on! It's a Leonberger. It was bred in Germany to look like a lion.
Final question! Make it count. Which dog breed is this?
The answer is an Azawakh. This slim sighthound comes from the Sahel region of West Africa.
Good boys and good girls, that's the end! How many breeds did you know? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow for a brand new quiz on Quiz Rush!
